instruction: I prefer to have my message preview pane below the message list instead of on the right. Can you help me change the message pane layout in Thunderbird to a vertical orientation?

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing message pane layout to vertical/below orientation in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks prefs.js for mail.pane_config.dynamic set to 2 (vertical layout). Using existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric. Similar complexity to original task.
metadata.verification: Verified that mail.pane_config.dynamic preference controls message pane orientation in Thunderbird. Value 2 represents vertical/below layout.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement: changing message pane layout to vertical orientation
Getter extracts the correct file (Thunderbird prefs.js) where preferences are stored
Metric function (check_thunderbird_prefs) properly parses prefs.js and checks mail.pane_config.dynamic == 2
Expected value is semantically correct: value 2 represents vertical/below layout as verified in metadata
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird window before reading prefs.js to ensure settings are saved to disk
Data flow is correct: task completion → prefs saved → window closed → file retrieved → preference checked
Metric handles edge cases (None results return 0.0)

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
